title: If gas-fired furnace burners can be adjusted individually, how should temperature variation be checked?
summary: Suneng's 2020 gas-fired bogie-hearth furnace proposal permits individual burner adjustment, mainly for temperature-uniformity commissioning. Control points are on both sidewalls opposite the burners. Match control points, commissioning measurements and actual loading. Independent adjustment does not establish that billet temperature differences during soaking already meet the requirement.
